The facts: Yang Moujia introduced a 12-year-old girl Li (born 2001, so age 12) to a hair salon run by Deng Moujia (already convicted of forced prostitution) and then handed her to Deng Mouyi (also convicted of forced prostitution) to be forced into prostitution. So the crime is forced prostitution of a minor (child). The relevant Chinese criminal law: "组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍他人卖淫" (organizing, forcing, inducing, harboring, introducing others to prostitution). Also "强迫卖淫" is a crime. Additionally, because the victim is a minor, it's "强迫卖淫罪" with aggravating factor of child. Also "组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫" includes "介绍卖淫". So the appropriate label from examples: For similar case of organizing prostitution, they used "组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫;协助组织卖淫". In the example with a brothel, they gave "组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫;协助组织卖淫". Here the defendant introduced a minor to a brothel and forced prostitution. So the crime is "组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫". Possibly also "强制猥亵" but not here; it's prostitution. So answer: [罪名]组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫<eoa>

Check if any other crimes: maybe "拐骗儿童"? No, they didn't abduct, they introduced. So just prostitution.
